features: ✨ Massive 60 Lakh Capacity & 6 Multi-Channels: Track up to 60,00,000 counts effortlessly! This smart digital ring features 6 independent channels, allowing you to chant and switch between 6 different mantras simultaneously without losing your progress.

🔋 2-Hour Fast Charge for 3 Months Battery Backup: Say goodbye to the hassle of changing tiny batteries! Equipped with a modern Type-C port, a quick 2-hour charge provides an elite, long-lasting battery backup of up to 3 months.

🤫 Premium Noise-Proof Button for Silent Chanting: Experience ultimate peace and focus during your sadhana. The ultra-durable, premium soft-touch button operates completely silently with zero clicking sounds, making it perfect for quiet environments.

🔄 180° Rotatable Screen with Vibrant LED Backlight: Designed for ultimate comfort! The bright, clear LED display ensures perfect visibility even in the dark and can be rotated 180 degrees, making it perfectly suitable for both left and right-handed users.

🔒 Smart Lock Function & Auto Power Off: Never lose a single sacred count again. The built-in lock feature prevents accidental clicks when carried in your pocket or bag, while the 10-minute auto-sleep feature smartly saves battery life.
